title: IPO Listing Report: BLS Polymers +79% / Bombay Coated +16% on Listing Day #shorts
desc:
IPO listing report, 18 Nov 2026: 4 mainboard IPOs that listed 3–5 Nov 2026 — issue price vs listing-day close vs 17 Nov close (NSE).
• BLS Polymers: 241x subscribed; ₹150 → ₹268.80 (+79.2%) → ₹275.50 (+83.7%)
• SFC Environmental: 9.5x; ₹330 → ₹426.10 (+29.1%, upper circuit) → ₹432.50 (+31.1%)
• M.K. Sons Fine Jewels: 5.1x; ₹162 → ₹162.20 (+0.1%) → ₹187.66 (+15.8%)
• Bombay Coated & Special Steels: 63.9x; ₹82 → ₹94.81 (+15.6%) → ₹83.41 (+1.7%)
Lesson: subscription shows demand on bidding day, not where the price goes next.
Sources: NSE daily prices via INDmoney (to 17 Nov 2026); final-day subscription from chittorgarh.com; listing prices cross-checked with Upstox, Business Standard, BusinessToday, Groww.
Not a buy/sell call. Not a recommendation to apply for any IPO. Education only, not investment advice. I may hold some of the stocks named.

• SFC Environmental: 9.5x · ₹330 → ₹426.10 (+29.1%, upper circuit) → ₹432.50 (+31.1%)
• M.K. Sons Fine Jewels: 5.1x · ₹162 → ₹162.20 (+0.1%) → ₹187.66 (+15.8%)
